lines.text: In the third year of the drought, the LORD tells Elijah to present himself to Ahab, promising rain.
Obadiah, who is in charge of Ahab's palace, fears the LORD and hid a hundred prophets in caves.
Ahab sends Obadiah to search every spring and valley for water, and the two men search together.

wrong_details.true: search for grass to keep the horses and mules alive
they divided the land, and each went his own way by himself

lines.text: Elijah meets Obadiah, who falls facedown and fears that Ahab will put him to death if he tells him.
Elijah promises to meet Ahab tomorrow and tells him to gather Israel on Mount Sinai.
